title.en: Procyclical and Counter Cyclical Economic policies
title.hi: Procyclical and Counter Cyclical Economic policies

definition.en: Procyclical policies amplify economic fluctuations by aligning with the business cycle, while counter-cyclical policies aim to stabilize the economy by moving against the business cycle.
definition.hi: Procyclical policies amplify economic fluctuations by aligning with the business cycle, while counter-cyclical policies aim to stabilize the economy by moving against the business cycle.

importanceInUpsc.en: Understanding these policies is essential for GS-3 as they form the basis of fiscal and monetary management in India. UPSC frequently tests the ability to analyze how government spending and RBI interventions impact economic stability during booms and recessions.
importanceInUpsc.hi: Understanding these policies is essential for GS-3 as they form the basis of fiscal and monetary management in India. UPSC frequently tests the ability to analyze how government spending and RBI interventions impact economic stability during booms and recessions.

learningOutcomes.en: Distinguish between procyclical and counter-cyclical policy frameworks.
learningOutcomes.hi: Distinguish between procyclical and counter-cyclical policy frameworks.

learningOutcomes.en: Analyze the role of fiscal and monetary tools in stabilizing the Indian economy.
learningOutcomes.hi: Analyze the role of fiscal and monetary tools in stabilizing the Indian economy.
